note: Submodule of graphql_compose. Exposes Drupal menus (query a menu by name -> nested link tree). Depends on graphql_compose_routes. Distinctive per-menu config key: entity_config.menu.<menu>.menu_route_enabled. Medium/hard cases are grounded in entity_config.menu.main.menu_route_enabled (baseline: absent). Evals avoid live GraphQL queries and 'drush cr'.

evals.prompt: What does graphql_compose_menus add to a GraphQL Compose schema, and which GraphQL Compose submodule does it depend on?
evals.expected_output: It adds Drupal menus to the schema (query a menu by name and get its nested MenuItem tree with titles, urls, attributes and children). It depends on graphql_compose_routes because menu-link URLs resolve through routes.

evals.prompt: In graphql_compose_menus, which per-menu config key makes each menu item also resolve its target content entity (with a load-cost warning for large menus)?
evals.expected_output: entity_config.menu.<menu>.menu_route_enabled = true in graphql_compose.settings.graphql_compose_server; it resolves each item's route.entity but loads all entities in the menu, so use only on small menus.

evals.prompt: Name some of the GraphQL types graphql_compose_menus provides for menus.
evals.expected_output: SchemaTypes MenuItem, MenuItemAttributes and MenuAvailable (plus the Menu and MenuLinkContent entity types).

evals.prompt: On this site, one menu has route resolution enabled in GraphQL Compose. Inspect the config and name the menu that has menu_route_enabled turned on.
Using graphql_compose_menus, enable per-item route resolution (menu_route_enabled) for the 'main' menu on the default GraphQL Compose server. Apply the change to the live configuration.
